About Us

DriveWealth is on a mission to make investing easier. We believe that everyone should have the ability to control their financial future, and that access to financial markets should not be limited by geography, wealth, or legacy systems. We are a global B2B financial technology organization dedicated to democratizing access to financial independence around the world. Our mission is realized through an API-based platform, empowering our partners to offer seamless investing and trading experiences to clients worldwide, all from their mobile devices. Our technology provides partners with a modern, extensible toolkit, enabling traditional investment workflows and innovative techniques like fractional share ownership. DriveWealth has evolved into a global platform offering trading of US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options.

There’s never been a better time to build a category-defining business and there has rarely been a team better positioned for this opportunity. Our culture blends the pace and agility of a fintech start-up with the impact, stability, and discipline of Wall Street. We encourage creativity and experimentation while ensuring institutional-grade execution and regulatory compliance in everything we do. Join us and help build the future of global investing!

About the Role

As a Product Marketing Analyst, you’ll help shape how our products are understood, valued, and adopted in the market. You’ll support the team by turning customer needs, market insights, and product capabilities into clear, compelling stories that connect with customers and support business growth.

In this highly collaborative role, you’ll work closely with Product, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to support product launches, strengthen our competitive position, and help equip customer-facing teams with the tools they need to succeed. You’ll learn from experienced marketers, contribute your own ideas, and see your work directly contribute to engagement and adoption.

What You’ll Do

  • Support product launches by coordinating timelines, tasks, and deliverables across teams
  • Contribute to product positioning and messaging by drafting and refining copy and key materials
  • Gather and summarize market and customer insights to share with the business
  • Partner with cross-functional teams and help bring the customer perspective into conversations
  • Track and report on campaign and launch performance, and recommend improvements
  • Help drive product adoption through supporting campaigns and resources
  • Create and maintain sales enablement materials such as one-pagers, battle cards, and decks
  • Conduct market and competitive research and keep competitor profiles up to date
  • Assist with content development and marketing campaigns

You Bring

  • 1-3 years of experience in marketing, product marketing, market research, or a related area
  • Clear, confident writing and presentation skills, with a knack for explaining complex topics simply
  • A curiosity about the market, including hands-on experience with research, competitor tracking, or gathering customer feedback
  • Comfort with tools like PowerPoint or Google Slides, and experience building decks, one-pagers, or other marketing content
  • A team-first attitude and a willingness to work with Product, Sales, and Customer Success
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to juggle multiple projects and deadlines
  • Comfort working with data, such as pulling together campaign metrics or survey results to spot trends
  • A customer-first mindset and an interest in understanding what drives customer decisions

Location

This role is open to candidates in the following locations: New York City, NY - Hybrid

  • This role is expected to come into the office on a cadence set by the Hiring Manager/Team.
  • If you're not based in one of the locations listed above, this role is not a fit, and we cannot accommodate remote work outside these locations.
  • Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. DriveWealth does not sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Pay Range: $100,000 – $120,000 USD

Working at DriveWealth

We do our best work when we're in the same room. To maintain the speed our partners expect, our New York, Chicago, and Lithuania teams work in office on a hybrid schedule. We've found that being physically side-by-side is the only way to solve complex problems in real-time and stay truly accountable to the products we ship. When you're here, you're working directly with the people making the decisions.

To support that work, we provide competitive compensation, equity, and a 401(k) match. We also offer Medical insurance, Dental insurance, Vision insurance, Disability insurance, and Paid Parental Leave, along with a wellness reimbursement, a company-provided phone, and a personal development allowance. Finally, we value the time you spend away from the office with generous Paid Time Off (PTO) and observed holidays.

Work Authorization

Applicants must possess the legal right to work in the country where the position is located at the time of application. DriveWealth requires all employees to provide original documentation verifying their work authorization on or before their first day of employment.

For US-based roles: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship. DriveWealth does not provide visa sponsorship or support for employment authorization, including transfers, at this time. Offers of employment are strictly contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the Company.

How We Think About AI

We leverage AI to work smarter and move faster. We seek AI-curious talent who are proactive about using emerging tools to increase signal quality, reduce friction, and improve outcomes to deliver products faster, provide better service to our partners, and to streamline processes. Your ability to leverage our internal tools and technology to drive results is as important to us as your core domain expertise.

Compensation

Pay is generally based on the level, complexity, responsibility, location, and job duties/requirements of the specific position. We then source candidates with the requisite skills, expertise, education, training, and experience.  If you are selected for an interview, please feel welcome to speak to a recruiter about our compensation philosophy and other available benefits. This role is eligible for base, bonus, equity, 401(k) match, and heavily subsidized benefits and perks.

Equal Employment Opportunity

To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. 

Agency Disclaimer

DriveWealth does not accept agency resumes. Do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other organization location. DriveWealth is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

About Paxos

Today’s financial infrastructure is archaic, expensive, inefficient and risky — supporting a system that leaves out more people than it lets in. So we’re rebuilding it.

We’re on a mission to open the world’s financial system to everyone by enabling the instant movement of any asset, any time, in a trustworthy way. For over a decade, we’ve built blockchain infrastructure that tokenizes, custodies, trades and settles assets for the world's leading financial institutions, like PayPal, Venmo, Mastercard, Interactive Brokers and Charles Schwab.

About the team

The Accounting team provides in-depth guidance to the rest of the organization on financial results, delivering insights that shape key decisions from daily operations to long-term strategy. Within Accounting, the Revenue team makes sure Paxos’s revenue is accurately billed, recognized and reported across its products and legal entities. The team solves complex accounting questions in an environment with new regulations, technologies and business models. That work supports Paxos’s mission of building a more open and inclusive financial system.

About the role

As a Senior Revenue Accountant, you’ll own key parts of the monthly revenue close, from preparing and reviewing accruals and journal entries to reconciling billing and revenue data. You’ll apply ASC 606 to new and existing customer arrangements and help document accounting conclusions. You’ll also find ways to make revenue processes more accurate, scalable and automated. You’ll work closely with Product, Sales, Treasury, Strategic Finance and Operations to understand how new deals and products affect revenue, and you’ll support audit requests. This role is critical to delivering accurate, timely revenue reporting as Paxos grows.

What you'll do

  • Prepare and review monthly revenue accruals, journal entries and supporting schedules as part of month-end close.

  • Reconcile billing, invoicing and revenue data across systems and resolve variances.

  • Support review of customer contracts and apply ASC 606 to determine the right revenue treatment.

  • Prepare revenue flux analysis and explain month-over-month changes.

  • Support external audit requests and prepare revenue-related workpapers.

  • Help maintain revenue accounting policies, process documentation and internal controls.

  • Identify manual processes and help redesign them for scale, including through automation and AI tools.

  • Partner with cross functional teams to understand new products and pricing and their accounting impact.

  • Immerse yourself in blockchain technology, stablecoins and enterprise crypto infrastructure, and in our regulation-first approach.

  • For folks with fewer than 4 years of relevant work experience, this is a hybrid role based in our New York City Midtown office, with in-office attendance required.

About you

  • 3+ years of combined experience in public accounting (audit) and/or in-house accounting, with a focus on revenue.

  • Hands-on experience applying ASC 606, including variable consideration, minimums and usage-based fees.

  • A bachelor’s degree in accounting and strong knowledge of US GAAP. A CPA or progress toward one is preferred.

  • Month-end close experience in NetSuite or another major ERP.

  • Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills, with experience building or maintaining reconciliation and accrual workbooks.

  • Experience using AI tools to improve accuracy or efficiency in accounting work.

  • Experience in fintech, financial services or a high-growth company (nice to have).

  • Excellent organizational, communication and cross-functional skills.

Important Notice for Paxos Applicants
Fraudulent accounts sometimes pose as Paxos recruiters on LinkedIn and other platforms, and fake websites sometimes impersonate our careers site. These scammers attempt to deceive applicants into paying for job opportunities or providing personal financial information.

To verify a legitimate Paxos opportunity:

  • Our only official careers site is paxos.com/careers

  • We only use @paxos.com email addresses

  • We never ask for payment or financial details to apply, interview, or work here

  • For technical roles, we do not perform a coding interview without prior screening by our engineering team

Thanks for your interest in Paxos!

About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Ramp is launching payments across the EU through its Swedish payment institution. Our European operations team (Europs) onboards European businesses and keeps them trading, across Ramp's own regulated entities and our card-issuing and payments partners. We're a small team that runs on frontier AI tooling: our operators build and use their own automations so they can spend their time on judgement, not admin. We're hiring a KYB/AML Analyst in Stockholm to review and onboard business customers of our Swedish entity, work directly with those customers to get them live, and resolve onboarding requirements raised by our partners. You'll join a small Swedish team and help keep onboarding moving every day as we grow.

What You'll Do

  • Carry out first-line (1LoD) KYB reviews of business customers onboarding with Ramp's Swedish payment institution: company verification, beneficial ownership, sanctions/PEP/adverse-media screening, and risk assessment

  • Decide standard cases end to end, and escalate complex or higher-risk cases with a clear rationale

  • Handle customer communications through onboarding: clear document requests, follow-ups and status updates

  • Resolve onboarding requirements from our card-issuing and payments partners for EU customers

  • Document decisions to a standard that holds up to second-line and regulatory review

  • Keep Swedish casework moving when teammates are on leave or handling incidents

  • Spend part of your time improving how we work: playbooks, templates and AI-assisted workflows

What You Need

  • 2–4 years of KYB / AML / onboarding experience at a fintech, payment institution, EMI or bank

  • Solid grounding in business customer due diligence: company registers, UBO identification, sanctions/PEP screening, and spotting red flags

  • Fluent English, written and verbal

  • Clear, friendly written communication with customers

  • Curiosity about AI tools and how they can make casework faster and better

  • Based in, or relocating to, Stockholm, with the right to work in Sweden

Nice-to-Haves

  • Swedish (strongly preferred)

  • Familiarity with Swedish sources and requirements (Bolagsverket, the beneficial ownership register, FI expectations under the Swedish AML Act)

  • Experience onboarding EU businesses across several jurisdictions

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Our Japan Marketing team’s mission is to engage priority audiences through impactful and relevant marketing campaigns and events, to drive growth in adoption of Stripe’s solution offerings. Japan Marketing is a sales-aligned team, partnering closely with the Japan GTM organization, including Sales, Sales Development, Solutions Architects, Partnerships, and others. Our team works across all customer segments, and at each stage of the customer lifecycle journey. As a member of the Japan team, this is a great opportunity to build and have an impact on the Japan business.

What you’ll do

You’ll be part of the Japan team, setting and executing our Japan marketing strategy while working hands-on and developing a trusted relationship with Sales to drive successful user outcomes. The Head of Japan Marketing will lead the field marketing function and deliver high-quality leads, pipeline, and revenue. You will build, lead, and grow a small team of marketing leaders and professionals, and establish how the team responsibly uses AI to sharpen customer insight, accelerate execution, and improve performance. As an early member of the team, you will have an opportunity to build the Japan marketing function at Stripe.

Responsibilities

  • Lead marketing for Japan across all customer segments, with strong coordination with Sales leadership; customer segments include enterprise, digital native, software platforms, small businesses, and startups 
  • Own key business and revenue metrics across the sales funnel (pipeline) and customer growth and retention. 
  • Develop a strong trusted relationship with the Japanese sales team, working closely with the sales leadership and sales development to jointly grow pipeline.
  • Partner with Asia Pacific demand generation and product marketing to refine our targeting and segmentation, and to identify, scope, and produce or localize compelling content, marketing assets and programs to drive demand
  • Define and execute full funnel Japan marketing plans including digital marketing, demand generation campaigns, sales prospecting programs and ABM, virtual and in-person field events, and third party tradeshows and conferences
  • Track, measure, and communicate program results, continually optimize for efficiency and scale, and seek to generate new global best practices through experimental efforts  
  • Be creative in finding new ways of advising a diverse range of personas about the value Stripe brings to businesses.
  • Set the Japan marketing team’s AI-enabled operating model, identifying high-value use cases across research, segmentation, localization, content development, campaign execution, measurement, and experimentation while maintaining strong judgment on quality, customer context, and responsible use.
  • Coach the team to adopt AI effectively, building repeatable workflows and raising the bar for strategic thinking, speed, and execution.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 10+ years of relevant B2B marketing experience leading a Japan marketing function across multiple customer segments including specific experience with content localisation and content marketing, event management, partnership marketing, and multi-touch campaigns to generate demand.
  • At least 5 years managing teams, with a track record of setting a clear strategy, developing talent, and leading through change
  • Proven track record of defining and executing Japan B2B marketing strategies that deliver against funnel metrics and KPIs
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills (both Japanese and English), including being able to convey complex topics with simplicity
  • Proven leadership capability and effectiveness working collaboratively and cross functionally:
    • Experience working closely with Sales teams, including joint planning and execution, driving disciplined lead follow up, and earning trust as a strategic business partner
    • Experience working as a Japanese leader partnering with global marketing teams, and leveraging central APAC capabilities and resources to lead growth in field marketing programs and events, executive programs and partner programs.
  • Experience scaling through/and or leveraging agency and contractor resources
  • Understanding and/or experience with CRM, account-based marketing, email marketing tactics, and marketing technology
  • Demonstrated AI fluency in a B2B marketing context: hands-on experience using AI to improve insight, planning, content, execution, or measurement; ability to evaluate output quality and risk; and experience helping a team adopt new tools and workflows

Preferred qualifications

  • A startup mentality with a bias to action and the ability to flex in a fast-paced industry and work environment
  • Experience marketing cloud services and/or software solutions 
  • Superb organization and project management skills and the capacity to manage multiple complex projects at once
  • Excellent analytical skills and the ability to craft actionable insights from complex data
  • Resourceful, creative and dedicated to achieving operational and creative excellence
  • Experience delivering tailored marketing content and experiences for customer segments spanning from early stage startups to the largest enterprise companies
  • Understanding of the payments, financial technology, and/or ecommerce industries and partner ecosystems
  • Demonstrated success delivering marketing programs with and through consulting and technology partners
  • High AI usage competencies.

Location: NYC (onsite only – not remote)

Alliance is the leading accelerator for crypto & fintech founders. Since 2020 we've backed 300+ startups (Rain, Pump, Synthetix, Pendle, and many more), now collectively valued at $17B+.

We're hiring a Head of Capital Formation to own fundraising for Alliance's venture funds end to end: strategy, pipeline, LP relationships, and close. You'll report directly to a General Partner.

What you'll do

  • Own the raise: Lead and execute Alliance's capital formation plan across institutional allocators (fund of funds, family offices, endowments, wealth management platforms, sovereign wealth) and HNWIs. You source, you pitch, you close.
  • Build and run the LP pipeline: Own lead sourcing, qualification, and pipeline management. Bring the right prospects to the General Partners at the right moment, and run the process through to signed commitments.
  • Be the voice of Alliance to investors: Serve as the main point of contact for prospective LPs. Communicate our strategy, track record, and edge clearly. Own the deck, data room, and investor materials.
  • Turn LPs into repeat LPs: Build long-term relationships with existing and prospective allocators. Keep them close between raises and bring them back fund after fund.
  • Shape the strategy: Work with the GPs on fund positioning, sizing, timing, and the long-term investor relations plan.

What we're looking for

  • Capital raising track record: 5+ years raising for venture, private equity, private credit, or hedge funds, with closed commitments from institutional investors and HNWIs you can point to. Venture fund experience strongly preferred.
  • An existing allocator network: Warm relationships with fund of funds, family offices, consultants, and HNWIs. This is a must have.
  • Crypto/AI fluency: 2+ years in crypto, fintech, or tech. You can hold your own with allocators on the thesis, not just the process.
  • Sales and relationship skills: Clear communicator, strong negotiator, high degree of professionalism and discretion.
  • Pipeline discipline: Can run a long sales cycle in a CRM, keep the funnel full, and automate where it makes sense.
  • Entrepreneurial and high agency: Self-driven, spots what's broken, and takes ideas through to completion.
  • Frequent travel: NYC is home base, but you'll be on the road often, including SF and internationally.

Strong qualifications (nice to have)

  • Raised for an emerging manager or an early fund, where you sold on conviction rather than a 20-year track record.
  • Relationships with crypto-native or AI-focused allocators.
  • Prior placement agent or in-house IR experience at a venture firm.

Why NOT join us

  • Not willing to get hands dirty: doesn't matter how important you were in past organizations; at Alliance we're all builders, not managers (even though many of us were managers in past lives). There's no IR team under you.
  • Prioritizing work/life balance: this role demands focus, hunger, and a career-defining level of commitment. You must be locked in.
  • Low agency: if you need someone else to set your priorities or keep you on track, you will fail.
  • You can't relocate to NYC. This is non-negotiable: our founders are here, our brand is strongest here, and so are we. You'll travel to SF often, but you'll live in New York.

Why join us

  • Own the raise, share the upside: salary plus fund carry. Your work decides how much capital the next generation of Alliance founders gets to build with, and who backs them.
  • Sell a real track record: 300+ startups backed since 2020, now collectively valued at $15B+, and a brand that's strongest exactly where the capital is.
  • Work with the most ambitious founders in crypto and AI. Learn firsthand from hundreds of startups succeeding – or failing.
  • Join a small, high-trust, high-performance team with outsized impact. We're ex-Meta, WhatsApp, Coinbase, YC, and have collectively founded multiple venture-backed startups.
  • We're backed by S-tier investors including Initialized Capital, Founders Fund, Multicoin, and Dragonfly, along with angels such as Balaji Srinivasan (ex-Coinbase CTO), Kevin Weil (CPO at OpenAI), Kevin Lin (Twitch co-founder), and Jeremy Allaire (Circle CEO), among many others.
  • Career accelerator: this role sets you up, experience- and network-wise, for any high-impact path in crypto/AI – at venture firms, startups, or raising your own fund.
  • Alliance startups are reinventing industries – from media to payments – and improving the lives of everyday people. You'll have a front-row seat as they change the world.
descriptions.job-0lmakty:
About the Role

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the financial strategy of a leading regional fintech. Reporting to the Chief of Staff, you will own the FP&A engine across multiple markets, products, and entities, with your analyses directly informing strategic decisions across new products, partnerships, and markets. This is not a reporting-coordination role: on the processes you own, your judgment is the deliverable. We are looking for someone who forms a view and puts their name on it, challenges the business when the numbers don't support the story, and is hungry to build rather than maintain. 

What You Will Do

  • Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A): Own budgeting, forecasting, and monthly and weekly reporting cycles - delivered decision-ready and owning the recommendation
  • Management & Board Reporting: Prepare board and management materials, distilling complex analyses into clear narratives on company performance
  • Business Partnering: Work with product and commercial leaders to challenge business logic, optimize unit economics, and drive accountability for growth targets. Surface variances and deliver actionable insights independently
  • Fundraising & Investor Relations: Support capital-raising efforts by leading data room preparation — assembling, analysing, and quality-checking the financial models, performance data, and supporting materials that underpin investor due diligence.
  • Process & Systems Enhancement: Partner with accounting, commercial, and data teams to proactively identify inefficiencies in finance systems and processes, applying automation and AI to sharpen analytics and strengthen reporting accuracy. 

What We Are Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field; MBA or professional certification (CFA, CPA) preferred
  • 8–10+ years of experience in investment banking, strategic finance, or corporate FP&A, ideally in a high-growth or tech-driven environment
  • Advanced financial modelling, with the ability to turn complex data into a recommendation, not just an output
  • Strong communication and storytelling, with the presence to influence senior stakeholders and hold a view in front of them 
  • Deep curiosity and understanding of fintech business models, unit economics, and market trends
  • Strategic, ownership-driven mindset — able to operate autonomously and lead cross-functional initiatives from concept to execution
  • Prior experience in fintech, payments, or high-growth technology companies is a strong plus

Having recently secured a $270M Series C—the single largest funding round in Southeast Asia over the past four years—we are backed by premier global investors including Y Combinator, Ribbit Capital, SoftBank, and SBI Holdings.  

To build world-class products, we assemble world-class talent. Supported by our fully remote work arrangement, our team spans Eastern Europe, the Middle East, India, and Southeast Asia, allowing you to work with brilliant engineers and builders from around the globe from wherever you are. We operate with an impact-driven purpose where everyone is the owner of our customers' satisfaction. Driven by a growth mindset and a fierce will to win, we refuse to settle and constantly push engineering boundaries.

We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Crypto Business Operations to own liquidity, and trading execution across our exchange. You will maintain a competitive market environment, optimize liquidity, and manage risk and PnL across trading activities. This role owns four core areas: liquidity improvement, USDT/IDR operations, FX tracking, and special projects that improve how the business and its operations run.

Key Responsibilities

Liquidity Improvement

  • Maintain competitive spreads, strong market depth, and reliable execution quality on the exchange
  • Collaborate with external market makers and liquidity providers to optimize liquidity
  • Monitor for trading anomalies, market disruptions, and liquidity risks, escalating when necessary

About the Company

Gemini is a global crypto and Web3 platform founded by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss in 2014, offering a wide range of simple, reliable, and secure crypto products and services to individuals and institutions in over 70 countries. The Department: Marketing

The Prediction Markets Operations team turns real-world events into clearly defined event contracts. We support markets across their full lifecycle—from an initial idea, through configuration and launch, into live operations, and finally to accurate resolution. Our work sits at the intersection of current events, marketplaces, and regulated products, and it demands precision at every step.

The team is responsible for making sure every contract is: clearly and objectively written, based on reliable, authoritative resolution sources, accurately configured, supported with appropriate images and content, thoroughly reviewed before launch, monitored while live, and resolved accurately and consistently.

The Role: Prediction Markets Operations Intern

This is a detail-oriented, hands-on internship for someone interested in marketplaces, operations, current events, financial technology, or regulated products. You will perform time-sensitive operational work and learn firsthand how prediction markets move from an idea to a live and, ultimately, settled contract.

Success in this role depends on accuracy, sound judgment, reliability, and operational discipline. Just as important is the willingness to escalate uncertainty rather than guess. You will support, coordinate, research, prepare, review, and execute work under established procedures, working closely with partners across Prediction Markets, Operations, Customer Support, Product, Engineering, Compliance, Legal, Design, Marketing, and our liquidity partners.

This will be a semester long internship program with 3 days a week in person at our New York City, NY office from January to April 2027.

Responsibilities

Contract Research and Market Listings

  • Research potential prediction-market contract ideas.
  • Help turn ideas into precise, objective binary questions.
  • Identify reliable and authoritative public resolution sources.
  • Flag ambiguity, potentially prohibited subject matter, or questions requiring Compliance or Legal review.
  • Prepare contract specifications, including outcomes, dates, descriptions, tickers, resolution criteria, and other listing details.
  • Create and configure event contracts in the Contract Management System, or assist with structured CSV uploads, under established procedures.
  • Support research and documentation related to product requirements and filings.

Quality Assurance and Launch Operations

  • Perform pre-launch and post-upload quality assurance.
  • Verify contract names, outcomes, ordering, start times, expiration times, resolution criteria, and designated sources.
  • Review dates and times carefully, including UTC-based fields.
  • Compare contracts with relevant external prediction markets when appropriate, and identify unintended differences in outcomes, timing, or mechanics.
  • Confirm that event and social images are present and appropriate.
  • Upload or update approved event images, social images, and display settings.
  • Coordinate launch information with internal stakeholders and liquidity partners.
  • Identify discrepancies and escalate issues before launch.

Customer and Live-Market Support

  • Review, triage, and investigate prediction-market support tickets.
  • Gather relevant facts, document findings, and route issues appropriately.
  • Monitor live markets for incorrect content, timing discrepancies, operational issues, or unexpected behavior.
  • Follow established incident-escalation procedures when urgent technical or operational issues arise.
  • Maintain accurate trackers, checklists, SOPs, and internal documentation.
  • Identify opportunities to improve repetitive workflows and reduce manual work.

Market Monitoring and Resolution

  • Monitor contracts approaching expiration or awaiting resolution.
  • Research outcomes using the contract’s designated resolution source.
  • Prepare a proposed outcome, source links, and a concise rationale for internal review.
  • Double-check resolution information against authoritative sources.
  • Escalate unclear, conflicting, delayed, or incomplete source information rather than guessing.
  • Execute approved market settlements in the Contract Management System after required training, review, and approval.
    • Settlement activity is performed only under established procedures, supervision, access controls, and approval requirements. Accuracy is critical, because completed settlements may not be reversible.
  • Document completed resolutions according to team procedures.

Scheduled Monitoring Coverage

  • Participate in a scheduled rotation for brief evening or weekend monitoring.
  • This is lightweight, scheduled coverage—not continuous or unrestricted on-call work.
  • Interns will primarily identify and escalate issues to the appropriate full-time team.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s, Associate’s, or Master’s degree.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • Strong written communication.
  • Ability to research information and distinguish authoritative sources from unreliable ones.
  • Sound judgment and a willingness to escalate uncertainty.
  • Comfort with detailed, repeatable, process-driven tasks.
  • Ability to manage time-sensitive work without sacrificing accuracy.
  • Dependability and follow-through.
  • Basic proficiency with spreadsheets and web-based business tools.
  • Ability to work in-office.
  • Availability for the scheduled, lightweight evening or weekend monitoring rotation.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Internship, academic, or project experience in operations, customer support, research, quality assurance, content operations, marketplaces, fintech, or another detail-oriented environment.
  • Familiarity with prediction markets, financial markets, sports, politics, economics, or major current events.
  • Experience with ticketing platforms, content-management systems, administrative tools, dashboards, or structured data entry.
